'''Enable Oklahoma Intrastate Transmission''' (EOIT) is a natural gas pipeline.<ref name=Enable>[http://investors.enablemidstream.com/sites/enablemidstream.investorhq.businesswire.com/files/event/additional/ENBL_2015_Barclays_Investment_Grade_Energy_vF.pdf Enable Midstream Partners, LP Overview, Barclays Investment Grade Energy and Pipeline Conference], Enable Midstream, Mar. 4, 2015.</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs entirely in Oklahoma.<ref name=Enable>[http://investors.enablemidstream.com/sites/enablemidstream.investorhq.businesswire.com/files/event/additional/ENBL_2015_Barclays_Investment_Grade_Energy_vF.pdf Enable Midstream Partners, LP Overview, Barclays Investment Grade Energy and Pipeline Conference], Enable Midstream, Mar. 4, 2015.</ref>
